output.reason: [ev-b8041528e3f8] says Argo CD 3.0 itself upgraded its bundled Helm to 3.17.1, and that only charts whose subchart values.yaml contains a `null` object are affected. Every environment upgrading to this release gets the new Helm. So the product-version{helm >=3.17.1} predicate wrongly treats Helm as a separate product whose version the customer controls: it is redundant at best and could wrongly drop exposed environments. The real deciding factor is whether the Helm sources Argo CD renders have null objects in their values.yaml. Those files live in chart and Git content that no configuration input shows, so the exposure should be the undecidable leaf alone (and an any[] with only one operand adds nothing).

correction.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 bundles Helm 3.17.1. Helm charts rendered by Argo CD whose subchart values.yaml contains a null object now render the K8s object overridden with that invalid null value, where before it was left unchanged with only a warning. An environment is exposed when its Argo CD-rendered Helm charts have such null values. Static configuration cannot show this.

exposure.needed: whether any Helm chart rendered by Argo CD (Application Helm sources) has values.yaml files for subcharts containing null object values
